reason: Sign-up validation: invalid input is now a 422 instead of a misleading 409, usernames follow one rule everywhere, and passwords need at least 12 characters when registering or resetting.

pipelineNotes.gitIsNowAuthoritative: As of 2026-09-24, main on hiteshhasija-lab/nuvrion genuinely reflects what's deployed (previously explicitly documented in HISTORY-RECONSTRUCTION.md as unrelated to reality). The repo was also made public that day so NOVAAPP01 could clone it with no stored credentials, matching how NovaConnect/NovaDesk-ITSM already work. The old, unrelated main history is preserved at the main-pre-replica-backup-20260924 branch on origin if ever needed. See HISTORY-RECONSTRUCTION.md's dated addendum for the full story.
pipelineNotes.fileLayout: Containerfile.base and Containerfile.overlay now live at repo root (Containerfile.overlay renamed from deploy/Containerfile.lab-overlay, which previously only existed inside individual release tarballs, not tracked anywhere canonical). package.json, contracts/, and tools/ are now git-tracked for the first time — previously base-image-only content with no canonical source.
pipelineNotes.serverCheckout: ~/nuvrion is a real `git clone` on NOVAAPP01 now (replaces the untracked, manually-maintained ~/nuvrion-native-build, retired to ~/nuvrion-native-build.retired-20260924 — not deleted). Same role as ~/novaconnect/~/novadesk: `git pull --ff-only origin main` here, then rebuild Containerfile.base, whenever package.json gains a new dependency (same two-tier base/overlay trap documented for NovaConnect — check before trusting a release, don't assume a clean overlay build means the new code's dependencies are installed).
pipelineNotes.systemdRaceFixed: upgrade-nuvrion.sh previously did a raw `podman stop`/`rm`/`run` swap even though container-nuvrion-api.service (systemd, Restart=always, enabled) and a wrapper script (~/.config/nuvrion/run-nuvrion-api.sh, targeting the movable localhost/nuvrion:stable tag) already existed — the exact race condition already fixed for NovaConnect/NovaDesk. Before this release, `:stable` was apparently being retagged manually outside the script after every real deploy (confirmed: the script itself never contained a `podman tag ... stable` line, yet the live container was somehow always running the right image). Fixed: the script now does `podman tag "$target_image" "$stable_image"` + `systemctl --user restart container-nuvrion-api.service`, letting the existing wrapper/systemd setup do the actual swap — verified this release genuinely moved the tag itself (all three of :stable/:0.1.150/the running container's image resolved to the same ID immediately after the script ran, with no manual intervention), and that an independent `systemctl --user restart` afterward still comes up healthy with the PEM keys/CA correctly re-injected by the wrapper script.
pipelineNotes.releaseAuthoring: Going forward, a new release is built the same way as NovaConnect/NovaDesk: make changes in the local Nuvrion git checkout, commit + push to main, tar the git-tracked overlay-scope paths (apps/ database/ modules/ providers/ Containerfile.overlay) plus release-manifest.json/SHA256SUMS.txt/RELEASE-NOTES.md (Nuvrion's own richer manifest schema, kept as-is — sourceBaselineCommit is now a real git SHA instead of the old placeholder string), scp to ~/nuvrion-upgrades/releases/Nuvrion-v<version>/, run --check then --yes. requiredMigration and the PEM/CA handling remain Nuvrion-specific real requirements, not present in the sibling apps' simpler scripts.
pipelineNotes.outOfScope: Nuvrion's 4-container pod topology (Caddy TLS termination, rabbitmq, worker), deploy/Caddyfile, and the agent-signing PEM/CA infrastructure are legitimate Nuvrion-specific architecture, deliberately left untouched by this restructuring.

concurrentDevelopment: Other sessions/agents (e.g. Gemini Spark, per prior STABLE-RELEASE.json history) may also deploy this app — check `ls ~/nuvrion-upgrades/releases/` and this file fresh before assuming the next version number.
